title: Record, Field, and Object as Data
definition: A record groups named fields that jointly describe one entity, event, or value; a JavaScript object can serve as one concrete record representation.
purpose: Keep related facts together under names that communicate domain meaning.
history: Records and product types have long represented structured values; object syntax is one language-specific implementation rather than the concept itself.
mental_model: A labeled form in which every field answers one defined question about the same subject.
analogy: An inventory card; useful because labels connect facts, but software also requires types, constraints, and ownership rules.
common_mistakes: Using positional arrays for named data
Treating JavaScript object syntax as a complete domain model
industry_notes: Record boundaries should follow one coherent domain concept and explicit ownership.
ai_notes: Ask AI to justify every field against a requirement and identify unrelated or derived data.
interview_notes: Ask when an object is merely a bag of properties rather than a meaningful record.
